photo_texturing.spec: Photo texturing for scanned rooms (user spec, 2026-09-12)

decisions.tiers: Root integration; Terra workers for iOS, baker, web
decisions.pose_record_v2: poses.json stays an array; each record adds metadata_version=2, frame_id (frame-NNNN, same number as frames/frame_NNNN.jpg, never renumbered), image_width/height (encoded), calibration_width/height (ARCamera.imageResolution), image_orientation='sensor' (unrotated camera pixels)
decisions.photo_manifest: artifact kind photo_manifest, id photo-manifest: {manifest_version:1, poses_sha256, frames:[{frame_id, sha256, bytes}]}; uploaded last, only after every listed frame uploaded
decisions.capture_to_room: SceneGraph.capture_to_room (row-major Mat4, excluded when null) set by ingest: Y-up to Z-up basis change then floor drop; projection maps room points back through its inverse into ARKit world
decisions.bake_graph: the requested revision's nodes, each placed at its revision-0 (capture) transform; nodes absent from revision 0 are left plain
decisions.build_key: sha256(pipeline version, geometry signature, capture alignment, manifest and LiDAR checksum); moves reuse capture build
decisions.jobs: table texture_builds (UNIQUE scan_id, build_key); jobs row kind='texture' with revision=build id; a separate worker thread claims only texture jobs
decisions.publish: scan_dir/textures/<build_key>/ written to a temp dir then renamed; served at /api/scans/{id}/textures/<build_key>/scene.glb as immutable
decisions.coverage_overlay: Embedded PNG photo atlases; separate PNG coverage masks; viewer offers aggregate node coverage overview
